# Lab 28.2: Real-time Fraud Detection

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a real-time fraud pipeline: transactions stream in through Pub/Sub, a continuous query enriches and flags them, BigQuery Graph finds suspicious networks, and AI.IF adds a second check.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create tables.**

CREATE TABLE cap2.transfers (txn_id STRING, from_acc INT64, to_acc INT64, amount FLOAT64, note STRING, ts TIMESTAMP);
CREATE TABLE cap2.accounts (id INT64, owner STRING, is_blocked BOOL, PRIMARY KEY (id) NOT ENFORCED);
INSERT INTO cap2.accounts VALUES (1,'Asha',FALSE),(2,'Ravi',FALSE),(3,'Unknown Ltd',TRUE),(4,'Meera',FALSE);</span>

2. **[CLI] Stream transfers in through Pub/Sub (Lab 3.6).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics create cap2-transfers
PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:service-$PROJECT_NUMBER@gcp-sa-pubsub.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor --quiet
gcloud pubsub subscriptions create cap2-to-bq --topic=cap2-transfers --bigquery-table=$PROJECT_ID:cap2.transfers --use-table-schema
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  gcloud pubsub topics publish cap2-transfers --message="{\"txn_id\":\"t$i\",\"from_acc\":$((i%4+1)),\"to_acc\":$(((i+1)%4+1)),\"amount\":$((i*700)),\"note\":\"urgent gift card payment\",\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"}"
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Continuous query to flag large transfers (Lab 11.2).** With an Enterprise reservation and the `bq-continuous` service account, write high-risk rows to `cap2.alerts` with `INSERT INTO … SELECT … FROM APPENDS(TABLE cap2.transfers, …) WHERE amount > 2000`.

4. **[SQL] Graph of money flow (Module 15).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE PROPERTY GRAPH cap2.MoneyGraph
  NODE TABLES (cap2.accounts KEY (id) LABEL Account)
  EDGE TABLES (cap2.transfers KEY (txn_id)
    SOURCE KEY (from_acc) REFERENCES Account (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (to_acc) REFERENCES Account (id) LABEL Sent);

GRAPH cap2.MoneyGraph
MATCH (a:Account)-[:Sent]-&gt;{1,2}(b:Account {is_blocked: TRUE})
RETURN DISTINCT a.owner AS sends_to_blocked;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

FROM cap2.transfers
WHERE amount &gt; 1000

6. **Review.** Write down the latency of each stage and what each layer catches: rules (amount), network (graph) and language (AI).

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Ingestion | Pub/Sub → BigQuery in seconds |
| Rules | Continuous query alerts |
| Network | Graph finds links to blocked accounts |
| Language | AI.IF flags scam-like notes |
